difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the construction attaching a point of the localized site to a point of the site together with an element of the value of that point at an object gives a bijection between such points lying over the given one and the elements themselves (statement lines 8966-8974). The proof is a complete argument: the values of the functors attached to the points are identified with pullbacks of representable sheaves (proof lines 8976-8984); the author compares the morphism sets and values in the two sites through two commutative diagrams, extracting an element from a point lying over the given point and conversely (proof lines 8985-9020); and the two constructions are checked to be inverse (proof lines 9021-9027). The non-formal content is the comparison of the two diagrams. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
